author: Ubisoft YouTube
text:
40 Years Through Our People’s Stories
As Ubisoft celebrates its 40th anniversary, we're taking a moment to look back at some memories that have shaped our journey. 

Here are some moment that made our teams laugh, inspired, challenged and filled them with pride. From career highlights to unexpected experiences along the way, each story offers a unique glimpse into life at Ubisoft.

Games are at the heart of what we do, but it's the people behind them who make Ubisoft what it is.
To everyone who has been part of this adventure over the past 40 years: thank you. ❤️
